tehran-online-2022.notes: contest_date 2023-03-16 is the Gregorian equivalent of the printed Persian date 25 Esfand 1401; it agrees with the pack. The PDF's text layer drops some Persian letters on extraction (e.g. final ی), so quoted Persian was read with that in mind.

sources.evidence: 13-page Persian PDF headed 'نوزدهمین مسابقه‌ی اینترنتی برنامه‌سازی دانشجویی ایران ... سایت تهران ... ۲۵ اسفند ۱۴۰۱' with problems A-J whose titles match the catalogue.
